# OH Lock & Key Solutions

> Licensed 24/7 locksmith serving all of Orange County, California. BSIS license #8663. Residential, commercial, automotive, smart locks, access control, safes.

## About

OH Lock & Key Solutions is a California-licensed mobile locksmith company headquartered in Santa Ana, CA. We dispatch BSIS-licensed technicians 24 hours a day, 7 days a week to every city in Orange County. Typical on-site arrival is 15–30 minutes.

- Business name: OH Lock & Key Solutions
- BSIS license: #8663
- Phone: 714-757-7574
- Email: ohlocksmithsolutions@gmail.com
- Hours: 24/7
- Service area: All of Orange County, CA (Santa Ana, Irvine, Anaheim, Huntington Beach, Newport Beach, Costa Mesa, Fullerton, Orange, Tustin, Garden Grove, Mission Viejo, Laguna Niguel, Laguna Beach, and every surrounding city).

## Services

- 24-hour emergency lockouts (home, business, vehicle)
- Residential locksmith (rekey, new locks, master keys, deadbolts)
- Commercial locksmith (storefront, glass doors, panic hardware, access control)
- Automotive locksmith (car keys, fobs, transponders, ignition repair)
- Smart and keypad locks (installation, setup, integration)
- Access control systems (keypads, fobs, mobile credentials, intercoms)
- Safe locksmith (combination changes, lockouts, repair, installation)
- Specialty hardware (high-security cylinders, restricted keyways)
